claims.text: A 60-second apnea event was detected in recording c03 starting at 2000-01-06T06:24:00+00:00 and ending at 2000-01-06T06:25:00+00:00 (window index 384).
The detector classified the window as an anomaly with a reconstruction error of 0.4166, exceeding the anomaly threshold of 0.2722; the normalized margin was 0.5303, and the anomaly margin was 0.1444.
The detector is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (model version apnea-06-c03_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset, with test patient c03 and fold ID apnea-06-c03.
No signal-level or attention-level evidence is available for this window; channel-level importance and temporal relevance are not provided.
The current event is supported by the detector's reconstruction error exceeding the threshold, but no signal or attention evidence is available to further characterize the anomaly.
